subject: Runtime on-call rota + cloud listing billing parity — next steps
messages:
From: Sophie Alvarez <sophie@datafoundry.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Align on runtime on-call and listing billing parity

Hi Marcus / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team loved the throughput numbers. We're finalizing the marketplace listing with CloudBridge and have two items blocking our internal launch sign-off:

1) Runtime on-call coverage for co-sell demos and P0 escalations (CloudBridge requires a named contact during marketplace onboarding).
2) Billing parity for reseller SKUs — CloudBridge needs a written parity commitment (trial billing and surcharge details) to approve the listing.

Can we get a short note on Redwood's intended on-call model (primary/backup, escalation SLAs) and a commitment window for parity pricing? We've attached a draft MRA with our expected terms to speed review.

Proposed 30-min sync this week — Wed or Thu morning PT — to walk ops and billing through the ask.

Appreciate it,

Sophie Alvarez
Head of Partnerships | DataFoundry Analytics
Sophie@datafoundry.io
Attachment: partner-mra-draft.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Alvarez <sophie@datafoundry.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Align on runtime on-call and listing billing parity

Sophie — thanks for the note and for attaching the MRA. Short answers up front: we can provide a named on-call rotation for co-sell demos (primary + 1 backup) with a 30-minute initial ack for P0s during business hours and a 60-minute ack for after-hours tiered escalation. On billing parity: Redwood can agree to match CloudBridge reseller trial terms for an initial 6-month window for this listing; we will need to confirm exact surcharge mechanics with Finance.

Next steps I propose:
- Internal handoff: Ben, can you confirm if Finance can sign off on a 6-month parity window and whether the surcharge will be applied at invoice or via SKU mapping?
- Ops: Olga, I’m looping you for the on-call rota mapping and to attach the concrete on-call CSV (we should call out primary, backup, and mobile contact).
- External sync: Sophie/Raj — if Wed 10:30 PT works, we can walk the MRA and the on-call template.

I pulled the key asks into this thread so everyone has context.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sophie Alvarez <sophie@datafoundry.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Align on runtime on-call and listing billing parity

Looks good. Finance is okay with a 6-month parity window in principle — need billing team to confirm whether surcharge is an invoice-level line item or embedded in reseller SKU.

I put a short note in the Drive folder (link below) with the pricing mapping we used for the last reseller pilot — that'll be our starting point.

Ben
Senior Manager, Alliances | Redwood Inference
Attachment: (link) https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-marketplace-listing-evidence
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sophie Alvarez <sophie@datafoundry.io>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Align on runtime on-call and listing billing parity

Thanks — attaching the proposed on-call rota CSV and a brief runbook excerpt that maps escalation steps to PagerDuty policies. Key notes:
- Rota: primary = partner-eng-oncall@redwood.com (week 1 Marcus), backup = partner-eng-backup@redwood.com (week 1 Ben).
- SLAs: initial ack 30m business hours (M-F 6am–6pm PT); after-hours ack within 60m, with phone escalation if not acknowledged in 90m.
- Escalation contacts (for marketplace P0s) will be published to the CloudBridge onboarding portal once the MRA is signed.

Two asks for Sophie/CloudBridge:
1) Confirm that the listed ack windows satisfy their marketplace gating checklist.
2) Provide the CloudBridge SKU mapping template (we'll align surcharge implementation accordingly).

Olga Petrov
Platform Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: oncall-rotas.csv; billing-parity-proposal.xlsx
From: Raj Patel <raj@cloudbridge.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Alvarez <sophie@datafoundry.io>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2029 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Align on runtime on-call and listing billing parity

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Wed 10:30 PT works for our side — confirmed.

On the two items:
- On-call: the ack windows you outlined meet CloudBridge's minimum for marketplace verification. Please publish the named on-call email and pager duty escalation URL to the onboarding portal once the MRA is signed.
- Billing parity: Sophie will upload the SKU mapping; Ben, if Finance can accept a 6-mo parity window with surcharge on invoice line item, Marketplace compliance will approve the listing.

I'll send a calendar invite with the preliminary agenda and CloudBridge's checklist attached. Looking forward to the sync.

— Raj
Partner GTM Lead | CloudBridge Marketplace
Attachment: CloudBridge-marketplace-checklist.pdf
